speed_percent.description: Advance of the shared emulated timeline divided by elapsed host time.

frame_work_p95_ms.description: P95 wall time to emulate a game frame, from its start until the emulated PPU ends it, over the latest valid frame samples; excludes pacing waits, the renderer finishing the frame on the other core and scanout waits.

frame_work_avg_ms.description: Mean wall time to emulate a game frame over the same frame sample window.

frame_sample_count.description: Number of valid frame samples, capped at 120; below 20 means WARMUP.

frame_gap_p95_ms.description: P95 interval between consecutive game frames handed to the display, over the latest 120 at the current speed.

frame_gap_avg_ms.description: Mean interval between consecutive game frames handed to the display, over the same window.

emu_fps.description: Complete game frames delivered by the emulated PPU per host second.

drw_fps.description: Distinct game frame IDs first selected for scanout per host second.

audio_queue_ms.description: Valid PCM sample frames not yet submitted to I2S, divided by output sample rate.

audio_min_ms.description: Minimum PCM software queue duration during the current rate window.

audio_underruns_total.description: Cumulative output underruns during normal playback in the current run.

audio_underruns_window.description: Output underruns during the current rate window.

heap_internal_free_kib.description: Currently allocatable internal 8-bit heap; does not represent all physical SRAM.

idle_core0_percent.description: Share of the rate window CPU core 0 spent in its idle task.

idle_core1_percent.description: Share of the rate window CPU core 1 spent in its idle task.

run_state.description: Current application state, independent from snapshot freeze state.

backend.description: Active emulation backend; INT is the interpreter, JIT is the dynamic compiler.

save_state.description: Cartridge save state; CLEAN requires durable completion of all pending modifications.

unhandled_errors.description: Number of unresolved errors requiring attention; not the historical error total.
